coreIdea: Memorize the comparison table: Best/Avg/Worst complexity + Stable? + In-place? for each of Bubble/Insertion/Selection/Merge/Quick/Heap/Radix/Counting sort.
mustRememberFormulas: Bubble/Insertion: O(n) best (sorted input), O(n²) avg/worst, stable, in-place
Selection: O(n²) always, NOT stable, in-place, fewest swaps (≤n-1)
Merge: O(n log n) always, stable, NOT in-place
Quick: O(n log n) avg, O(n²) worst, NOT stable, in-place
Heap: O(n log n) always, NOT stable, in-place
Radix/Counting: O(n) linear when range/digits bounded, stable
Comparison-sort lower bound: Ω(n log n) = ⌈log2(n!)⌉
